# Pull request templates

Pick a template by adding `?template=<file>` to the compare URL, for example:

`https://github.com/nishanth-kj/1nternet-Downloader/compare/sprint_0.1.0...my-branch?template=feature.md`

| Template | Use for |
| --- | --- |
| `feature.md` | New features |
| `bugfix.md` | Bug fixes |
| `docs.md` | Documentation-only changes |

Every PR should say what was verified and what wasn't (see `docs/contributing/testing.md`),
and link its issue with `Closes #<number>`.
